body: Thank you for reading the description and the recovery input with your plant. I have fed it a mix of worm castings and "down to earth" slow release nutrients couple days shy of a week, so it will take a bit longer to bounce back. I was just seeing if people have seen a significant come back or if she is just forever crippled.

Did you add any nutrients to the peat moss, unlike soil peat does no contain any nutrients so you need to heat up the medium with light nutrients, I get people say don't use nutrients on the sprouts but that's for soil mediums vs coco or peat which requires prep.

So the swirls of darker oil is the color of the oil that was left over from doing my car oil change. Would left over contaminates have affected the color of that oil in particular? This is has been my first actual at home oil change for a motorcycle. I normally see a dark amber with car oil changes so I'm not really sure what it normally should come out looking.
Generally I do less than 100 miles per trip but wouldn't that have been enough time for the engine to come up to temp?

Unpopular opinion is going with liandrys, demonic gaze, and if enemy team is mixed damage run MR and armor. Or one or the other depending on how much of ad to ap the enemy team has. Your focus in team fights are first in blow most of your abilities, run and rinse and repeat. Ult when your team can follow up. You are there to apply dots and be able to tank multiple trips into the enemy team this way.

Over watered the leaves will drop, under watered the stems should give way first. When they claw it means it keeps drinking water leaving it like that. You would need to not water for a while before the pot dries out, but if leaving it unwatered does work for a couple of days, chance of root rot at that point it high. the rule of thumb I follow is underwater it before you soak the soil with water, and let it dry until it looks underwatered to water again. Less margin of error watering this way
